notes:
Account background: mid-to-large research org inside Crestfall Capital. Primary product is internal knowledge portal for equity research, fixed income models, and client-facing briefs. Looking to replace brittle keyword search with modern RAG: dense retrieval + LLM reranker. Key constraints: data residency in US-only regions, customer-managed KMS, audit trail for regulatory exams. Preferred deployment: Dedicated (reserved GPUs) inside Crestfall VPC or on-prem appliance.

Technical goals and targets:
- Index scale: target 150M-250M documents (research notes, transcripts, models). Expect steady-state 200M docs.
- Embedding pipeline: incremental refresh cadence: nightly full diff + realtime ingestion for high-priority analyst edits. Currently validating open-embed-1536 and a higher-dim 3072 variant for better precision on short financial passages.
- Retrieval latency target: 80-150ms for top-k vector lookup at 99th percentile. End-to-end RAG latency target: <450ms (retrieve + rerank).
- Reranking approach: use LLM-based reranker as a secondary pass on top 100 candidates; prefer a small, warm model on dedicated GPU to keep cost predictable.
- Cost sensitivity: wants predictable $/query metric. Target blended cost per query <= $0.06 for typical queries (includes retrieval + rerank).

Security/compliance notes:
- Must support Crestfall KMIP-compatible HSM or AWS KMS with customer key policy.
- Audit logging mandatory for queries and model outputs (retention 7 years for regulatory sampling).
- Data residency: all model weights and inference endpoints for production must be in US-East or US-West private deployment.

POC specifics so far:
- In POC we ingested 10M docs and benchmarked retrieval latency with a single dedicated pool (g4dn-equivalent). Observed 95th percentile 220ms for retrieval (needs optimization). Rerank stage added ~180ms when called cold; warm-cache drops to ~60-80ms.
- Current concerns called out by infra: index sharding, KV-cache warmup on failovers, and autoscaling for spikes during earnings season.

Sales/Procurement signals:
- Budget request for Dedicated reserve submitted to procurement (internal ref: PR-CR-0312). Forecast: procurement window opening March-April, legal negotiation May.
